observation.visible_scene: A black steam locomotive with a red front pilot is on a track beneath a steel gantry, venting dense white steam from its smokestack and lower machinery. The steam forms a large rolling cloud across the foreground and around the locomotive.
visible_changes: The locomotive's front and side become progressively larger and shift toward the right edge of the frame, indicating it advances slowly along the track toward the camera/right during the excerpt.
The background gantry and left support structures remain broadly in the same frame positions while the locomotive changes relative to them, supporting object motion rather than a simple camera pan.
White steam continuously rises from the chimney, drifts upward and left, and changes shape.
The ground-level steam cloud thickens, spreads, and billows leftward, repeatedly obscuring and revealing parts of the locomotive's wheels and lower side.
The locomotive's red cowcatcher and headlight area remain visible but become more cropped at the right edge as it approaches.
outside_clip_unknowns: Whether the locomotive was already moving before the first sampled frame or continues moving after the last frame beyond this crop.
The full train consist, track layout, and any operator or control actions outside the visible frame.
The exact speed and direction of the locomotive relative to the camera, given partial occlusion by steam.
uncertain_details: Minor apparent changes in framing could include slight camera zoom or movement, but the fixed background suggests the dominant change is the locomotive moving toward the camera/right.
The steam's leftward drift may be due to wind or venting, but the cause is not visible.
Individual wheel/rod motion is not clearly resolved through the steam.
